Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused specifically on the security/compliance gates we discussed — SOC 2 evidence intake, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, DPA redline and data retention requirements.

High-level proposed MAP (draft):
- Week 0 (Aug 17): Evidence intake workshop (60 min) — introductions, artifacts overview, assignment of owners
- Week 1 (by Aug 24): SOC 2 evidence bundle (initial drop) + completed CAIQ partial answers
- Week 2 (by Aug 31): DPA redline back-and-forth; target signature via DocuSign if possible
- Decision milestone (Sep 7): Go/no-go based on evidence completeness and legal sign-off

Immediate asks for the workshop:
1) Who from Aureus will attend (security, legal)?
2) Any non-negotiable evidence items (e.g., specific control IDs or retention timeframes)?
3) Preferred workshop times (we're available Tue/Wed next week 10:00-14:00 PT)

Attached: SOC 2 intake template (soc2-intake.xlsx), blank CAIQ export (caiq-questionnaire.json), and a placeholder for a DPA redline. I also sketched a data-flow stencil (data-flow.svg) that we can iterate on in the workshop.

If that timeline looks reasonable to you, I'll send a calendar invite and an initial Drive folder with artifacts and a simple tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear plan; that looks useful. We'll plan to send a small group to the workshop: myself (legal lead), Mark (sec-ops), and Priya (data governance). A couple of constraints from our side to call out up front: 

- DPA: our legal team will want to own the initial redline. Please flag any clauses that are typical blockers (e.g., sub-processing, breach notification SLAs).
- Retention: Aureus has a regulatory requirement to retain certain transaction logs for up to 7 years; anything affecting log access/storage needs to be explicit.
- Data flow: we need confirmation that no customer PII is exported outside our approved AWS accounts without encryption-at-rest and appropriate KMS.

Workshop timing: Tue Aug 17 at 11:00 PT works for our team.

I'll also add our security mailbox (sec-ops@aureusbank.com) to the drive once you share it. For the DPA, our legal lead asked that Redwood upload the DPA redline to DocuSign or share a tracked Word doc (we prefer DocuSign for signing).
